title: Type Size Explorer
description:
Print a table of every fundamental type with its size and range.
```
Type          Bytes   Min                    Max
char          1       -128                   127
short         2       -32768                 32767
int           4       -2147483648            2147483647
long long     8       -9223372036854775808   9223372036854775807
float         4       1.17549e-38            3.40282e+38
double        8       2.22507e-308           1.79769e+308
```
requirements: Use `sizeof` and `std::numeric_limits<T>::min()/max()` (note: for floats `lowest()` is the most negative)
